notes.title: Update notes for v1.2.0
notes.content:
Thanks you for playing the game and leaving an honest review, always looking into you feedbacks and suggestions to improve the game, here is the v1.2.0 which complete the previous update:

New & Improvements
* Now you can random change cat appearance along side changing the name 
* Several minor UI & Gameplay improvements

Bug Fixes
* Several minor bug fixing

Happy Playing!

notes.title: Update notes for v1.1.0
notes.content:
Thanks you for playing the game and leaving an honest review, always looking into you feedbacks and suggestions to improve the game and here is the v1.1.0 which includes:

New & Improvements
* Ability to name your cat family members
* Cat’s Meow SFX different pitch based on age phase
* New cat body skins
* Now you know the salary each cat generate
* Several UI position/color improvements 
* Price & Salary rebalancing

Bug Fixes
* Sometimes small kitten hide behind older family members
* Upgrade house will break TV election
* Achievement Fixes
* Localization Fixes

Happy Playing!
